rules.name: standard
rules.description: One 60 s round. +1 point per 10 px driven forward. Up to 3 fuels on the map; each is +100 and refills the tank by 25 (of 100). Every throttle and turn burns fuel (idle 1/s, throttle +4/s, steering +1.5/s, braking nothing); an empty tank stops the engine, and a car that coasts to a stop is out. Wall hits cost health by impact speed, and scraping along a wall by distance.
